title: I Will Follow
lyrics_original: I will trust in you alone
I will trust in you alone (trust in you alone)
If this life I lose, I will follow you, yeah
I will live for you alone
All I need in you alone, in you alone      || Where you go ||
In you there's freedom for my soul
In you there's joy, unending joy
And I will follow         || Where you go ||
author_english: Chris Tomlin, Jason Ingram, Ruben Morgan

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకు రూతునా వెంబడి రావద్దనియు నన్ను విడిచి పెట్టుమనియు నన్ను బ్రతిమాలుకొనవద్దు. నీవు వెళ్లు చోటికే నేను వచ్చెదను, నీవు నివసించుచోటనే నేను నివసించెదను, నీ జనమే నా జనము నీ దేవుడే నా దేవుడు;
bible_verses.english: But Ruth replied, 'Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.'

bible_verses.telugu: ఆకాశములు భూమికిపైన ఎంత యెత్తుగా ఉన్నవో మీ మార్గములకంటె నా మార్గములు మీ తలంపులకంటె నా తలంపులు అంత యెత్తుగా ఉన్నవి.
bible_verses.english: As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.

bible_verses.telugu: నీ స్వబుద్ధిని ఆధారము చేసికొనక నీ పూర్ణహృదయముతో యెహోవాయందు నమ్మక ముంచుము
bible_verses.english: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You that Your ways are far higher and better than anything I could plan for myself. Today, I choose to place my trust entirely in You, letting go of my need to see the whole journey ahead. Wherever You lead, I desire to follow, trusting in Your goodness and unfailing love. Keep my heart attuned to Your voice and give me courage to walk faithfully in Your steps. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You that Your ways are far higher and better than anything I could plan for myself. Today, I choose to place my trust entirely in You, letting go of my need to see the whole journey ahead. Wherever You lead, I desire to follow, trusting in Your goodness and unfailing love. Keep my heart attuned to Your voice and give me courage to walk faithfully in Your steps. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Following Jesus is an invitation to step out of our own plans and rest in His perfect guidance. Even when the path ahead feels uncertain or higher than our limited vision, we can take each step with confidence knowing that all His ways are good and sure. As you sing today, surrender your need to control the outcome and fix your heart on the One who goes before you. He is faithful to lead you in every season.
